compliance.status: compliant via overlay zones and mandatory set-aside; unmet need acknowledged

notes: Westwood Borough: DCA Present Need = 19 (rehab via Structural Conditions Survey); Prospective Need = 235 (court-fixed May 13, 2025 per Judge Corriston). Vacant land assessment shows RDP = 0; all 235 prospective need becomes Unmet Need. Borough addresses obligation through: (1) LB-RM Overlay Zone on Block 701 Lots 1-8, 10-13, 16 (~6.52 acres in LB-1 zone along Broadway): 20 du/ac density, 15% rental / 20% for-sale set-aside. (2) RW-RM Overlay Zone on Block 2001 Lot 62; Block 2003 Lot 2; Block 2210 Lots 1 and 3.01 (~2.2 acres in RW Retail/Wholesale zone): 20 du/ac density, 15% rental / 20% for-sale set-aside. These overlay ordinances were required under the April 24, 2018 Settlement Agreement with FSHC (Third Round), approved by Judge Farrington 9/6/2018. Court also required Mandatory Set-aside Ordinance (applicable to all multifamily). Additional incremental credits: 106 Old Hook Road (Block 1802 Lot 25, 1 affordable unit, ZBA approved, not yet constructed); Block 802 Lots 1 & 2 at Irvington St/Broadway (1 affordable unit, under construction). Prior Round credits: Westwood House Block 801 Lot 18 = 182 rental affordable units; Mid Bergen Community Housing Block 1601 Lot 13 = 3 units; Spectrum for Living Block 1607 Lot 24 = 6 units. Implementing overlay ordinances (Ord 266 LB-RM and Ord 267 RW-RM) are in the court library.
